common_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final illustrated dark fantasy RPG battle background for TheSevenSimulationRPG, continuing chapters 1–3.
Style/medium: hand-painted 2D storybook game environment, restrained dark cartoon illustration, clean dark brown/charcoal contour linework, broad readable shapes, two or three painterly shaded planes per material, subtle brush texture, atmospheric depth. Like the existing burning medieval fort, twisted forest and golden desert illustrations visible in this conversation. NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D, NOT pixel art, NOT anime, no excessive intricate ornament. Landscape environment only.
Composition: wide panoramic 16:9 landscape. Slightly elevated eye level, medium-wide distant environment. Clear open ground in middle and foreground for battle UI; scene landmarks in the middle band, their bases at 45–73% canvas height. Top 12% mostly quiet sky or ceiling. Bottom 20% spare empty ground, safe to crop away. Complete single coherent image, no panels, no frame.
Lighting: dark readable game background, local colored light on charcoal shadows, natural material color variation; keep highlight areas small. No global flat color filter.
Constraints: no readable text, runes, letters, labels, numbers, interface, logos, signatures or watermarks. No heroes, active enemies, giant boss character, or foreground portrait. Story is communicated by the environment and abandoned props.
Style precision: keep detail economical, medium-weight clean charcoal outlines and broad flat painted forms, only 2–3 shading tones. Match the simple chapter 3 desert and chapter 2 forest references seen earlier, not a detailed matte painting. Snow and stone use broad clean color areas, no photographic grain.

Match the medium-weight dark clean outline, broad simple planes, soft painted two-tone shading and economical low detail of image 2 desert and image 3 forest. Reduce village buildings and tiny individual twigs/rocks; smooth snow into broad painted areas. No photorealistic texture.
